bio.text: James Coleman, a Democrat, has represented District 33 in the Colorado State Senate since January 2021 and serves as President of the Senate; he previously served in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 7) from 2017 to 2021.
Coleman was born in Denver, Colorado, and earned a B.A. in psychology from Oral Roberts University.
His career experience includes working as vice president of community engagement for ACE Scholarships and serving as vice president of the board of directors at Highline Academy.
